evals.prompt: From prd.md, produce a technical design for the search feature: a tech-design.md plus at least one ADR.
evals.expected_output: A tech-design artifact whose frontmatter carries decisions, components, and risks, plus at least one ADR with context, decision, alternatives, and consequences. No application code is written.
assertions: A tech-design artifact is produced with frontmatter listing decisions, components, and risks
At least one ADR is produced with Context, Decision, Alternatives considered, and Consequences
At least one ADR records a genuinely rejected alternative with the rationale for rejecting it (not a strawman)
Every PRD goal is traceable to a named component or an explicit decision
Only design documents are written; no application code is created

evals.prompt: Using case2-context.md, decide between server-side and client-side rendering for the new results page and record the decision.
evals.expected_output: An ADR that weighs both options, states the chosen one with a rationale, and notes the consequences.
assertions: The ADR records both alternatives that were considered
A single option is chosen with a rationale that engages the stated constraints (SEO indexability and mobile first-contentful-paint), not generic pros and cons
The consequences/trade-offs of the chosen option are stated

evals.prompt: Using case3-context.md, design the data layer under the stated constraint that no new external datastore may be added.
evals.expected_output: A design that honors the no-new-datastore constraint, with risks calling out the trade-offs, committed as an artifact under docs/sdlc/<feature>/.
assertions: The design honors the stated constraint: indexing and querying are mapped onto the existing relational database, with no new external datastore introduced
The relevance-quality and/or latency-at-scale risk created by the constraint is explicitly called out
The output is written as an artifact under docs/sdlc/<feature>/

component.purpose: Produce a technical design (ADRs plus a tech-design artifact) from requirements, weighing alternatives; it writes design documents only, never code.
